mapper.select: SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, c.parent_category_id AS parentCategoryId, COUNT(*) AS paymentCount, SUM(e.amount) AS totalAmount FROM expense e JOIN category c ON c.category_id = e.category_id WHERE e.member_id = #{memberId} AND e.payment_status = 'APPROVED' AND DATE_FORMAT(e.payment_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_category_id ORDER BY SUM(e.amount) DESC, c.category_id
